name: Membrane Taxonomy Theorem

intrinsic.accepted_condition: K_hat_j <= Theta for every accepted predictive stage
intrinsic.overread: public shadow or section projection treated as full carrier witness

sectioned.budget: Theta_sec or section budgets plus cross-section defect
sectioned.accepted_condition: stacked section block budget or explicit nonclaim excluding cross-section recombinations
sectioned.overread: section diagonal budgets treated as global membrane

bundle_fiber.budget: Theta_b with essential-sup or integrated budget
bundle_fiber.accepted_condition: fiberwise budgets plus uniformity/gluing defects or scoped integrated shadow
bundle_fiber.overread: fiberwise finiteness treated as uniform global membrane

protocol_indexed.overread: route-local/diagonal budgets treated as protocol union

core_theorem: For any declared type tau, accepted membrane iff K_tau <= Theta_tau iff no unresolved native type-tau critical-pair witness.
closure_scope: Formed closure/layer only; raw substrate, public shadows, and undeclared probes are outside scope.
